financings_after_balance_sheet.what: Underwritten public offering of 12,390,254 ADSs at $9.25 (closed April 26 and May 3, 2024, incl. over-allotment); net proceeds are the company's estimate
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: On April 26, 2024 and May 3, 2024, we completed an offering of our ordinary shares through the sale and issuance of a cumulative 12,390,254 ADSs, at an offering price of $9.25 per ADS
